parameters.characterId: kyu unit ID as an unpadded decimal string
parameters.story: V26 story-title group_id; optional context for the sprite viewer
parameters.scenario: V26 raw source title; optional context for the sprite viewer
parameters.variant: exact kyu variant ID such as 100100_r
parameters.animation: exact CocoStudio movement name such as wait
parameters.character: optional NFC text fallback when characterId is unavailable

configuration.viewerBase: search-page-only target base URL; absolute, root-relative, or document-relative
configuration.spriteCatalogUrl: viewer deployment override via window.MAGIRECO_SPRITE_CATALOG_URL or meta[name=sprite-catalog-url]

encoding.hashFallback: the same key=value form is accepted when query values are absent

messageShape.inputContext: flat canonical/legacy fields, or a payload/context object; payload takes precedence over context and flat fields
messageShape.trust: host validates event.source, exact event.origin, type, and bridgeRevision=1
